newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says wants lasting robust, strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says wants lasting robust, strong dollar.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Tuesday that he would like the dollar to remain strong and robust.
"I would like a strong dollar, but even more a robust dollar...for this exchange rate to be lasting," he told parliament.
France's economy needed both currency and interest rate stability, he said, adding that interest rates in France were exceptionally low.
"The factor that should please us today is that the dollar has risen without us having to modify the exchange rate between the franc and the mark," he said.
"What is important is for the dollar to be lastingly robust without threatening the historically low levels of our interest rates," he added.
Group of Seven finance ministers and central bankers indicated at a meeting in Berlin earlier this month that they wanted the dollar, which had been rising sharply, to stabilise.
